references.title: Brian Weatherson, “The Problem of the Many,” Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy (Winter 2023 archive)
references.support: Secondary philosophical reference: §§1–7 and 9 explain the cloud setup, Geach’s Tibbles reasoning, composition and identity alternatives, semantic vagueness, and the distinct tail/parthood case. It surveys contested responses rather than establishing consensus or replacing primary texts.

references.title: Andre Gallois and Irem Kurtsal, “Identity Over Time,” Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy (Spring 2026 archive)
references.support: Secondary reference: §§1 and 4 provide broad context for persistence, diachronic identity, and part-change puzzles. Consulted as context only; it is not the source for Geach’s Tibbles many-candidates argument or Weatherson’s separate Tibbles-and-tail story.
